title: Benchmark Execution
summary: Orchestrates end-to-end benchmark runs by coordinating scenario data loading, model adaptation, metric evaluation, and result presentation. Manages execution workflows across single and multi-GPU environments.

nodes.label: Manage Run Lifecycle
nodes.title: Run Management
nodes.description: Coordinates benchmark execution from start to finish. Handles single-GPU, multi-GPU, and SLURM-based job scheduling. Supports re-evaluation of existing runs.

nodes.label: Load Scenarios & Data
nodes.title: Scenario & Data Loading
nodes.description: Retrieves benchmark scenarios and test data. Preprocesses and augments data as needed. Supports diverse medical and general-purpose datasets.

nodes.label: Define Run Specifications
nodes.title: Run Specifications
nodes.description: Defines benchmark configurations including model selection, adapter settings, and evaluation parameters. Factory functions generate task-specific run specs.

nodes.label: Adapt Model to Task
nodes.title: Model Adaptation
nodes.description: Applies task-specific adapters and augmentations to prepare models for evaluation. Handles prompt engineering and input transformations.

nodes.label: Generate Model Outputs
nodes.title: Inference & Clients
nodes.description: Executes model inference across language, vision, audio, and image generation models. Manages API calls and local model execution.

nodes.label: Compute Metrics
nodes.title: Evaluation & Metrics
nodes.description: Calculates performance metrics, annotations, and robustness measures. Generates detailed evaluation reports and visualizations.

nodes.label: Present Results
nodes.title: Result Presentation
nodes.description: Summarizes benchmark results and creates interactive dashboards. Generates plots, tables, and comparative analysis across runs.

nodes.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
nodes.title: Infrastructure Support
nodes.description: Provides tokenization, proxy services, window management, and logging. Enables distributed execution and remote service communication.

groups.label: Orchestration
groups.title: Execution Control
groups.description: Manages the overall benchmark workflow and coordinates all downstream components.

groups.label: Data Preparation
groups.title: Input Setup
groups.description: Loads scenarios, preprocesses data, and adapts models for task-specific evaluation.

groups.label: Execution & Evaluation
groups.title: Core Processing

groups.label: Output & Support
groups.title: Results & Infrastructure
groups.description: Presents results and provides underlying infrastructure services.
